name: Zadok
overview: The name Zadok appears in Scripture associated with several individuals who served important roles in Israel's history. Notably, Zadok was a high priest during King David's reign, linked to the priestly line through his father Ahitub, and was recognized as a man of valor. His daughter Jerusha is mentioned as the mother of kings Jotham and Ahaz, highlighting Zadok's connection to the royal lineage. Other references identify Zadok as a priest, a treasurer of the temple, and a returned exile, demonstrating the name's association with faithful service and leadership within the community.
